entities.name: Anda Šafranska
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Anda Šafranska is a Latvian-born chess player who holds the title of Woman Grandmaster. For many years, she was one of the highest-rated women's chess players in Latvia. She won the Latvian Chess Championship for women eight times: 1982, 1984, 1990, 1991, 1993, 1994, 1996, and 1997.
